topic.readerProblem: Buyers weighing Nightwatch for AI visibility tracking need to know what it really costs now, why people look elsewhere, and which AI-visibility tools fit a smaller or different need.
topic.connection: AEOeye's free audit and $29 one-time report serve the one-off baseline job; the page routes readers to AI-only trackers or to Nightwatch itself when ongoing monitoring or rank tracking fits better.

assessment: The page replaces an outdated Nightwatch story ($32 base plus $99 beta AI add-on, $131+) with the current pricing page, where AI prompts are included in every plan. It gives three reasons people leave, a six-column comparison from each vendor's own pricing page, a per-prompt arithmetic check labelled as ours, a neutral fact box from AEOeye's crawler access study, and when Nightwatch is still the right choice. It does not claim hands-on use, rankings or outcomes for any product, and it states AEOeye is a one-time audit, not a tracker.

sources.supports: Starter/Professional/Agency plans, 500/2,500/7,500 keywords, 50/150/500 AI prompts, 1,500/4,500/15,000 AI answers per month, yearly rates and Save amounts (used to derive monthly-billing prices), engines list, 14-day trial without card, auto-billing FAQ, Professional extras (white label, Looker Studio, API), Black Friday banner.
AI tracking metrics, daily updates, platform list including Microsoft Copilot, vendor claim linking citations to Google rankings.
Lite $29/month, 15 prompts, four engines at entry, Claude/Gemini/AI Mode as add-ons, free trial without stated length.
Starter $95/month, 50 prompts, choose 3 models, daily tracking, 1 project, unlimited users; monthly AI answers defined as prompts x models x frequency; Start free trial button.
Growth $100/month, 1 brand, 50 prompts, 8 models incl. Claude/Gemini/Grok/Perplexity; 14-day trial, card required.
Free plan with $25 credit (300 credits) and five platforms; Starter $295/month, 3,600 credits, 1 credit = 1 AI response, 11 models.
Brand plans: free 7-day trial (50 prompts) and custom Enterprise; no published paid price.
